test_interval_bound_propagation: test jax_verify.interval_bound_propagation to propagate input bounds through a sequential neural network model
test_forward_crown_bound_propagation: test jax_verify.forward_crown_bound_propagation to compute tighter output bounds using CROWN technique
test_backward_fastlin_bound_propagation: test jax_verify.backward_fastlin_bound_propagation to compute output bounds using backward FastLin relaxation
test_jittable_input_bounds: test converting IntervalBound to jittable form and running bound propagation inside a jax.jit compiled function
test_stateful_model_bound_propagation: test propagating bounds through a Haiku model with batch normalization state using hk.transform_with_state
